scope: Same definition applied to both preserved runs: movement follows one layer and recipient across distinct submitted frames through arrival; multiple targets in one frame do not count as movement. An actual travel request must precede fixed contact and have a pre-contact flight draw at/after its authored checkpoint.
limits: Predictions use frames that submitted paint and do not prove later source admission. Only the actual candidate run can validate its requests.
One pre-contact frame at3x can still show motion through the arrival frame. This correction changes the observer, not any authored renderer or acceptance threshold.
No physical audiovisual onset or human listening proof.
